svg.text: OEIS A240443 — Square Grid Avoiding Arbitrary-Orientation Squares (sq-any)
Maximum painted points on an N x N square lattice containing no 4 corners of ANY square (axis-aligned or tilted)
Verified Frobenius 8x8 Certificate: 34 Painted Points (0.07 s)
Forbidden Shapes: Axis-Aligned AND Tilted Squares
Every side vector (a, b) with a > 0, b >= 0 generates a 4-literal clause
OEIS A240443 Calibration Ladder & Open Frontier (8 CNFs)
Known optimal through N = 10; N = 11 lower bound 58 (Israel 2016)
- Encoding: N^2 point vars + 4-clauses + Sinz counter (>= m); no symbreak.
- Calibration: Frobenius solves sq-any_n8_m34 in 0.07 s (#1 of 5 solvers).
